device.description: 10-bit voltage-output DAC with 3-wire serial interface (SPI/QSPI/Microwire), 12- or 16-bit word
device.note: tlc5615.pdf (SLAS142E) p.1 pinout, p.2 terminal functions, p.3 recommended operating conditions, p.4 timing requirements, p.5 Figure 1, p.8 power-on reset (DAC register zero), p.9-10 serial interface, data sequences, SPI connection (CPOL = 0, CPHA = 0), daisy chaining

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: 10-bit DAC register; an internal circuit resets it to all zeros on power up (p.8)

commands.name: Write
commands.note: 12-bit sequence (10 data bits MSB first + 2 sub-LSB don't-care bits) or 16 bits with 4 upper dummy bits first (Figures 10-11, p.9); data shift in on SCLK rising, CS rising transfers the shift register to the DAC register: the last 12 bits before CS rises are decoded

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions), p.4-5 (timing, Figure 1), p.8 (power-on reset), p.9-10 (serial interface, SPI mode, daisy chain)
notModeled: analog: voltage output (x2 of REFIN), reference input
DOUT daisy-chain output (16-bit shift register output, changes on SCLK falling, holds its last bit while CS is high): not modeled, the pin is never driven
update rate / settling time (12.5 us) and timing checks
variants: single device; C and I temperature grades
